primary_population_unit.reason: the biological design is an island-series comparison and island-level grouping can be fixed before genotype information; genetic response may not redefine populations

secondary_site_level.eligibility: site IDs must exist in the response-free 2026 registry before any genotype processing

integrity_rules.site_coordinate_rule: individual coordinates may vary within a predeclared site_id; derive one response-free site centroid as the arithmetic mean of individual coordinates
integrity_rules.island_centroid_rule: equal-weight arithmetic mean of response-free site centroids within each island; do not weight by number of sampled individuals per site

population_rule.population_drop_after_genotype_access: PROHIBITED except a separately frozen pre-genotype QC failure rule

site_rule.site_identity_role: site identities are preserved for provenance and future relation construction
site_rule.Niijima_multiple_sites: retained as distinct site IDs in registry but pooled to Niijima for the primary genetic endpoint
site_rule.site_level_genetic_contrasts: not part of the primary promotion decision

output_if_pass: five island centroids computed with equal site weights

pre_genetic_amendments.reason: site_rule contained a keyless string and was therefore not machine-parseable
requiring exact coordinate identity within site_id would confuse within-site individual GPS variation with registry drift and would sample-size-weight island centroids

next_authorized_stage: freeze IBD, IBE, transition-world family and occurrence-relation predictors from the passed response-free registry; genotype processing remains forbidden
